description: This file contains CMake configuration scripts for building Metal shaders, including functions for compiling Metal code, linking libraries, preprocessing shaders, and setting up environment variables related to Xcode and OSX SDKs.

methods.name: metal_to_air
methods.description: Compiles Metal source code into an intermediate form using xcrun metal.

methods.name: air_to_metallib
methods.description: Links object files into a metallib using xcrun metallib.

methods.name: metal_to_metallib_h
methods.description: Preprocesses Metal shader source, embeds it into a header file with additional includes.
